scope.invariant: Policy decisions over trusted native snapshots are deterministic and IO-free, reject stale or unauthorized calls, preserve data-risk restrictions and enforce bounded arithmetic; compatibility never grants activation authority.
scope.selectedChain: Trusted native snapshot/call/now -> am_plugin_policy::evaluate -> native Result<(), Denial>; direct authority::authorize caller excerpt only. negotiate is checked through the existing bounded decode/corpus harness.
expansionReasons: The direct runtime caller identifies where native snapshots and now originate; no runtime port, persistence or revocation chain is expanded.
Protocol/schema checks establish the documented decode precondition of negotiate without manually auditing generated DTOs or the full SDK.
exclusions: Product-code fixes and permanent regression tests
SQLite schema-3 initialization, serialization, corruption and atomic durability
Named commit/revoke races, expectedVersion, receipts, provenance and cancellation of blocking jobs
Production command registration, grants/session creation, native consent and exact target admission
B15 anonymous transport, B16 package recovery, live app/browser inspection, root final acceptance, commit and push

declaredStatus.claim: am-plugin-policy depends only on protocol; trusted callers inject time, identity, scope, grants and usage. Runtime/application authority remains separate.
references: docs/zh-cn/跨平台/架构/重构分板块排查计划.md:153
declaredStatus.evidenceLimit: Historical S12 schema-1 and pre-S13/S15 stage statements are historical evidence; current desktop/native guides establish schema 3 and current delivery. This batch does not accept either persistence or delivery.

checks.question: Does the pure policy owner remain free of concrete IO, databases, global clocks and application authority?
checks.detail: Only protocol is a production dependency; the complete checked closure contains protocol/serialization and proc-macro support, without Tauri, SQLite, network or clock implementations. std::io is limited to the explicitly local corpus example.

checks.question: Are time and authority inputs injected, with decisions unable to become renderer bearer grants?
checks.detail: evaluate accepts borrowed native snapshots and explicit now_ms, returning Result<(), Denial>. Direct caller constructs the inputs and maps denial locally. Actual native caller/session provenance is deferred to B14-runtime-ports.

checks.question: Do identity, epoch, enablement, independent deadlines, exact scope and operation grants fail closed?
checks.detail: Existing regressions plus four audit probes reject mismatched and empty identities, changed epochs, disabled policy, independent expiry/deadline equality, scope-prefix guesses and every ungranted operation.

checks.question: Are historical private levels, secret rejection and combined network/data risks preserved?
checks.detail: The maximum historical/current level prevents narrowing the selected data from removing private-egress restrictions. A network grant requires approval across all operations after private history. Secret history/current data remain denied even with approval. Offline public reads do not mutate retained private history.

checks.question: Are all three budget dimensions bounded without overflow, and unknown required contracts rejected before activation?
checks.detail: checked_add rejects over-limit and overflow in requests/bytes/concurrency; 18 independent budget boundary cases pass. 183 shared TS/Rust decoding/schema/negotiation cases pass, including unknown required capability/version rejection, optional skipping, unsupported forms/external policy and missing required contributions. Compatibility is explicitly not activation authorization.

probeEvidence.retention: Ignored local audit probes/logs only; no permanent product test was added.
probeEvidence.recoveredHarnessIssue: The first standalone rustc attempt used target/debug rather than target/debug/deps for dependency search (E0463). The corrected harness passed all 8 tests against the unchanged Cargo-built library. Initial failure remains in probe-initial-compile.log and probes-initial-result.json; it is not a product finding.

missingEvidence: Pure policy results do not prove actual native caller provenance or persisted identity/epoch validation.
Atomic values/provenance/receipts, durable revocation and commit races require separate runtime/storage/named-operation batches.
Cancellation retaining an executing blocking-pool permit, unknown schema and corrupt-grant behavior are not checked.
Production absence of fixture/grant/session/general-relay IPC requires separate command-boundary evidence.
No production artifact/resource graph or live runtime evidence was collected. Live UI is unnecessary for this IO-free algorithm batch; B14 as a whole remains pending.
Root full gates were not rerun for this scoped audit without product/native implementation changes; final collection remains B21.

dependencies.detail: Generated consistency and 183 differential cases were rerun as direct evidence only; SDK subentries and complete native protocol ownership remain separate.
